tps25961.fact: At 3.3 V the internally controlled nominal output slew is 4.43 V/ms and IINRUSH=COUT*SR; active current limiting bounds overload.

tps3435.fact: TPS3435CAKAGDDFR has a 1.44..1.76-s watchdog timeout, zero watchdog startup delay, 500-us maximum device startup time and a 180..220-ms WDO-low interval.

mspm0c1106.fact: The lower 32 kB flash is rated for 100k erase/program cycles with 1-kB sectors; remaining flash is rated for 10k cycles.

u214.fact: C12 is a fitted 470-uF input reservoir.
